phase_a_orientation.summary: OrderService.createOrder is the transactional submission chain. It first reserves inventory for the order SKU and quantity, then creates and saves a CONFIRMED PaymentIntent keyed by the order ID. Next it changes the Order from DRAFT to READY, saves it through OrderRepository, publishes an ORDER_CREATED event with the order ID, and returns the order. All calls are synchronous and ordered; an exception before completion prevents later steps from running.
